surveyMethod: Full grep of docs/** and tests/contracts/** for restriction lexicon (BLOCKED, STOP, must not, do not, never, prohibited, forbidden, approval required, CTO approval, owner approval, fixed slot, assigned URL, entrypoint comment, dirty worktree, one task per branch, draft by default, production URL, browser start, browser navigation, login, merge approval, and Korean variants 금지/중단/승인 필요/명시 승인/작업 중단). Each hit was read at bounded heading/paragraph level and judged against MVP_AGENT_GOVERNANCE.md. Runtime/DB/API/UI/CSS/PR #3432/tree-comments/Scout/moment-Social/source code were excluded per task scope (Section 6). Additionally, all root and subdirectory README.md files (16 found via `find . -name README.md` excluding .git/node_modules) were scanned with the same restriction lexicon; README CTO-approval gates found (functions/README.md, modal_compute/README.md, netlify/README.md, netlify/functions/README.md, netlify/sql/README.md) are all API/runtime/backend/DB scoped and excluded per Section 6; CSS-archive and secret-handling READMEs contain no agent-governance process restriction. README scan completed with no additional qualifying agent-governance item.

trancheCriteria.NOW: Document is reachable from docs/ops/ops_index.md or docs/doc_index.md read-first lists (or repeatedly referenced as current guidance) AND contains an active-looking restriction that classifies an MVP-de-escalated item (one-task-per-branch, draft-by-default, fixed-slot absence, missing entrypoint comment, dirty worktree, CTO-assigned URL, routine merge, production/localhost as pre-merge proof) as an automatic blocker/approval/stop gate.
trancheCriteria.DEFER: Document is historical/task-specific/incident-specific/closed-PR scoped, already aligned to MVP by #3444, reachable only via secondary reference, or conflicts partially but is a deeper follow-up than the minimal first tranche.

inventory.heading: Merge-readiness interpretation
inventory.summary: Mandates that a missing fixed-slot assignment be reported as BLOCKED_SLOT_DECISION_MISSING (not PASS) for editor detail UI PRs, and requires PR Preview+runtime or fixed test slot for Auth/API/data-loaded editor scenarios. Treats fixed-slot absence as an automatic blocker.
inventory.reason: ops_index.md read-first (item 13) links this doc as current criteria. MVP_AGENT_GOVERNANCE.md lists fixed-slot absence as advisory, not an automatic blocker, and lists browser/login/production/fixed-slot as allowed by default. The BLOCKED_SLOT_DECISION_MISSING mandate conflicts with canonical policy. Retain verification-depth guidance within the named Issue #521 context; mark agent-blocker interpretation NON_NORMATIVE_OUTSIDE_NAMED_CONTEXT.

inventory.heading: Dirty Worktree Handling / Fixed Test Slot Tracking
inventory.summary: Requires STOP when git status --short is not empty and 'Require clean worktree assignment'; also states PASS is forbidden if slot SHA is not confirmed and missing slot must be reported BLOCKED/NOT_VERIFIED. Treats dirty worktree and fixed-slot/SHA absence as automatic blockers.
inventory.reason: ops_index.md read-first (item 22) links this doc. MVP_AGENT_GOVERNANCE.md states dirty worktree is not an automatic BLOCKED and fixed slot/SHA absence is advisory. The STOP-on-dirty and PASS-forbidden-on-slot-SHA language conflicts with canonical policy. Mark agent-blocker interpretation NON_NORMATIVE_OUTSIDE_NAMED_CONTEXT; preserve legitimate parallel-work coordination content.

inventory.heading: GitHub CLI usage rules / PR and Issue safety guidance
inventory.summary: States 'Merge is forbidden unless the CTO explicitly approves that merge in the current task' and 'PR merge requires explicit CTO approval in the current task.' Requires CTO gating for routine merge and for creating new local credential files.
inventory.reason: ops_index.md read-first (item 11) links this doc. MVP_AGENT_GOVERNANCE.md allows routine squash merge after remote diff review, CI green, and expected-head confirmation, and lists repeated CTO approval for routine merge as advisory, not a blocker. The merge-approval mandate conflicts with canonical policy. Mark merge-approval language NON_NORMATIVE_OUTSIDE_NAMED_CONTEXT; preserve all secret-handling/HARD_SECURITY content unchanged.

inventory.heading: Core rule / Fixed test slot URL / Auth- API-dependent surfaces
inventory.summary: Lists 'production URL used as pre-merge PR proof' as forbidden provenance and states localhost/production are not valid pre-merge final proof; requires a fixed test slot to be 'acceptable only when CTO assigns it to the target PR/ref'. Gates fixed-slot usage behind CTO assignment and forbids production/localhost as pre-merge proof.
inventory.reason: ops_index.md read-first (item 6) links this doc. MVP_AGENT_GOVERNANCE.md lists production, PR preview, localhost, and fixed slot as allowed by default, and de-escalates fixed-slot absence and CTO-assigned URL as non-blockers. The CTO-assigned-slot gate and production-pre-merge ban conflict with canonical policy. Mark conflicting agent-blocker interpretation NON_NORMATIVE_OUTSIDE_NAMED_CONTEXT; preserve URL-provenance/SHA-evidence reporting guidance.
